title: FlowMLLab: An Open-Source Framework for Reproducible CFD-to-Scientific-Machine-Learning Experiments
description: Version 1.3.0 of FlowMLLab adds checksummed rarefied-cavity, monatomic-shock, and diatomic-shock DSMC data; a complete article-reproduction lecture and notebook; and an improved six-field micro-nozzle validation workflow to the installable CFD-to-scientific-ML framework.
